content.short: Solana is a highly scalable layer 1 blockchain designed for mass adoption.
content.description: Solana is a blockchain platform built to host decentralized, scalable applications and services. Launched in 2017 as an open-source project by the Solana Foundation in Geneva, with development of the blockchain carried out by Solana Labs in San Francisco, it emphasizes high throughput and low transaction costs. By prioritizing efficiency, Solana aims to enable faster confirmation times and cheaper execution for decentralized apps, competing with other major blockchains such as Ethereum.
